title: Migrate Cyclotron-web to a Papyrus Markus publication
description: Next.js marketing site (app/ routes, content/articles, interactive previews) at cyclotron.anth.us. Convert prose pages to Markus; interactive chart/carousel/drift previews become Papyrus islands as in Prospectus-web (web/island). Keep the shared-UI dependency on Cyclotron.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Scoping (2026-10-17): Cyclotron-web is not a thin marketing site. 28 client components, about 20 routes (home, how-it-works, developers, services, pricing, learn/[slug], use-cases/[slug], articles/[slug], editorial-evaluation, recordings and recordings/[id]) plus 11 development-only preview pages. Interactive pieces: run playback and recording charts (learning curve, confusion matrix, review effort, comparison) driven by components/recordings/* JSON fixtures, Framer Motion, and shared UI imported from the Cyclotron package. Four Markdown articles in content/articles. Production is the cyclotron-marketing CodePipeline in the cyclotron-production account (merge main -> CodeBuild -> cyclotron.anth.us); local-only CI via npm run ci.

Plan in slices, each shippable on its own: (1) prose routes (how-it-works, developers, services, pricing, learn, use-cases, articles) to Markus with the Papyrus shell and the Cyclotron brand/theme; (2) recordings and playback charts as Papyrus islands following Prospectus-web web/island; (3) swap the pipeline build step from next build to the Papyrus projection build; the pipeline change goes through the existing CodePipeline owners/DevOps, not a local AWS deploy. Slice 1 must keep every current URL.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Slice 1 progress (2026-10-17): the article and Learn guide pages (11 pages) are now Markus content in AnthusAI/Cyclotron-web, merged to develop as PR 133 (not yet on main, so not deployed).

What moved: /articles, the four /articles/<slug> pages and the six /learn/<slug> guides. Same URLs, same visible text, screenshots pixel-identical at 1280 and 390 px. The guide copy moved out of components/learn.ts into content/learn/*.md (the loader keeps the same shape). The shared header, footer and cards are rendered from the existing React components into a JSON model; Papyrus/Markus converts the Markdown and writes the pages into out/ after next build. The CodePipeline buildspec is unchanged (npm run build still produces out/); the script bootstraps Python 3.12 with uv and the pinned papyrus-newsroom[markus]==1.2.0 and anthus-markus==0.5.1.

Scope change for slice 2: how-it-works, developers, services, pricing, the Learn index, use-cases (list and detail) and recordings each embed animated pictograms or recorded runs, so they cannot be plain Markus pages. They move with the islands slice. The header logo animation is static on the Markus pages until the island work hydrates it.

Open risks: (1) the CodeBuild bootstrap of uv and Python 3.12 is untested on the real project; if it fails the build goes red and nothing deploys, the site stays as it is. (2) Promotion develop to main (the deploy) is waiting on Ryan's yes.
